evaluator: Independent holdout evaluator using a fictionalized Margaret Morse analytical lens; not Margaret Morse, not speaking for her, and providing no endorsement.
evidence: Within one click, the [About page](https://staging-b.jamieburk.art/about) explicitly names the through-line as “Systems people can inhabit” and connects Open House, WOW List, Sunday Dinner/196, NYC Artist Coalition, and source-backed team memory across artistic, civic, technical, and social practice.

The About page presents three distinct, concrete systems loops—Harry J. Epstein Company, NYC Artist Coalition/FairRentNYC, and Sunday Dinner/196—each organized as relationships, model, interface/use, and learning/continuity. Their linked case studies remain reachable within the rubric’s two-click limit.

The [Sunday Dinner/196 page](https://staging-b.jamieburk.art/work/196-sunday-dinner) makes inhabitation tangible through invitation, food, welcome, artist onboarding, facilitation, independent access, follow-up, and minimal continuity records. It treats hospitality and trust as operating infrastructure while withholding participant-level records.

The [FairRentNYC page](https://staging-b.jamieburk.art/work/fair-rent-nyc) joins campaign websites to working sessions, town halls, testimony, hearings, minutes, action trackers, source maps, and question logs. It repeatedly distinguishes Jamie’s implementation and organizing contributions from collective campaign and policy outcomes.

The [WOW List page](https://staging-b.jamieburk.art/work/wowlist) connects Sunday Dinner calendars, organizer vocabulary, natural-language publishing, followable communities, adoption support, and later coalition organizing. It credits Richard Caceres and the wider organizer community, labels database counts as historical rather than current activity, and describes the 2026 surface as a limited return rather than a restored calendar.

The [Harry J. Epstein case study](https://staging-b.jamieburk.art/work/harry-j-epstein) keeps Jamie’s responsibility legible as Technical Project Manager and Web Systems Lead, showing a concrete listen-frame-implement-verify-continue workflow. Its growth claim uses contribution language and explicitly withholds private analytics, customer data, revenue details, credentials, vendor terms, and internal operations.

The [source-backed team-memory lab](https://staging-b.jamieburk.art/lab/source-backed-team-memory) exposes the Known/Open/Protected method, human correction gates, and a concrete date correction propagated across public surfaces. It clearly states that the work is an early method—not production SaaS, surveillance, automated trust, or a substitute for judgment.

The [homepage](https://staging-b.jamieburk.art/) and [resume page](https://staging-b.jamieburk.art/resume) immediately identify the target role as Technical Project Manager focused on Product Operations and Implementation, then connect that role to requirements, workflows, documentation, launch support, onboarding, civic tools, community systems, and durable handoffs.
gaps: The candidate digest is supplied for judgment binding but is not visibly displayed on the reviewed public pages.

Sunday Dinner/196 is intentionally summary-only; its displayed photograph discloses that the photographer is unresolved while stating that the image received bounded human review. Participant-level corroboration remains protected and therefore was not observed.

This public-web-only review did not verify protected records, private aggregates, downloadable resume contents, off-site sources, or external campaign sites; those remain unobserved rather than inferred.
safety_findings: No blocking public-safety or source-integrity problem was observed on the reviewed surface.
Collective credit is explicit across FairRentNYC, WOW List, and Sunday Dinner/196; policy outcomes and community activity are not presented as Jamie’s sole accomplishment.

Privacy and consent boundaries are unusually visible: guest lists, contact details, private correspondence, access instructions, coalition strategy, legal-review context, customer data, and unapproved images or quotations are identified as protected or omitted.
Historical and current states are distinguished for WOW List, CallNYC, recovered social records, and the team-memory lab; historical counts are not presented as current adoption or resident outcomes.
The resume page publicly discloses that an approved downloadable artifact contains a phone number. The PDF itself was not opened, so its contents were not assessed.
This evaluation does not authorize publication, deployment, indexing, testimonial use, or release of protected material.
recommendation: Pass PR-015 at score 4 for the candidate bound above. Preserve the current collective-credit, consent, privacy, historical-status, contribution-language, and human-review disclosures; this holdout judgment is not a release authorization.
